name: Columned Temple
description: Stepped stone platform, a peristyle of columns and a gabled pediment.

name: Timber Hall
description: A steep timber hall with crossed gable finials and a stone hearth beside it.

name: Pylon Temple
description: Twin sloping pylon towers flanking a gate, with relief bands and a flagstaff.

name: Ziggurat Precinct
description: A mud-brick stepped terrace with three stairways meeting at the first stage and a small temple on the top terrace.

name: Assembly Enclosure
description: A round earthwork with its bank outside the ditch, a central mound and a timber hall: a gathering place, not a fort.

name: Twin-Shrine Temple
description: A stepped platform with a twin stairway rising to two shrines side by side, one painted for rain and water.

name: Court of Arinna
description: Polygonal stone gateway between two towers opening on a walled court with an inner sanctuary.

name: Courtyard Shrine
description: A compound around an open courtyard with a veranda on carved posts and a rain basin, set beside grove trees.

name: Gabled Shrine
description: A raised wooden honden with a deep gabled roof and crossed finials, approached through a torii gate.

name: Fire Altar Enclosure
description: An open ritual enclosure with a round household fire, a square offering fire and a grass-strewn altar between them under a simple shed roof.
